title: decree attention file frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a file decree writes in .decree/attention/, in one of two shapes by `kind`. `run`: .decree/attention/<id>.md, written when run <id> needs a person: it failed, was interrupted, waits in a `person` state, or is a migration waiting for an interrupted child run. `manual-stop`: .decree/attention/manual-stop.md, written by `decree stop`, which holds the queue until a person deletes it. A markdown body follows: what happened and the exact command that continues the run, or how to resume. The files are read-only: answer with `decree event` or a reply, continue with `decree process --retry`. A `.md` file in the folder whose frontmatter is missing or does not match this schema holds the queue as if it had `holds: true`. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Attention.

run.description: A run that needs a person: .decree/attention/<run>.md.

kind.description: A run that needs a person.

run.description: The run's id; the file is `<run>.md`.

message.description: The migration's file name for a migration run, else `inbox`.

status.description: `failed`: finished in `failed`. `interrupted`: stopped by a signal, or by a crash found later from a stale lock. `waiting`: waits in a `person` state for a reply, or is a migration waiting for an interrupted child run, which the body names.

state.description: The state the run is in; for a failed run, the state it failed from, which `decree process --retry` continues in.

since.description: When the run's status changed, RFC 3339 UTC: the `ts` of its last event.

holds.description: Whether the file holds the queue: the run has a `hold` file (written by the built-in `keep` script). While any file holds, `process` and `daemon` start and continue no runs.

manualStop.description: Written by `decree stop`: .decree/attention/manual-stop.md. The runs going when it was written finish their current step loop; no run starts or continues until a person deletes it.

since.description: When `decree stop` wrote the file, RFC 3339 UTC; a later `decree stop` leaves it.

holds.description: The file always holds the queue.
